patterns.note: Content sections are centrally aligned and extremely sparse, separated by vast expanses of black space, creating a sense of depth and focus on individual statements.
All textual elements, from headings to body text and navigation, consistently use a monospaced, uppercase typeface, conveying a precise, technical, and almost code-like aesthetic.
The design is dominated by a deep black background, with vibrant, soft-focus gradient elements (purples, pinks, oranges) used sparingly as ethereal accents and focal points.
As the user scrolls, content sections reveal themselves with a subtle fade-in or slide-up effect, often accompanied by minimal graphic elements (like arcs or dots) animating into view.

The initial hero features a large, glowing orb that appears to parallax or scroll out of view to reveal the main content, while a minimal, sticky navigation bar appears at the bottom of the viewport after initial scroll.
Each content section follows a consistent structure: a prominent, centered heading, a subtle graphic element (e.g., a horizontal arc with a moving dot), and a concise, centered body paragraph.

technique_notes: Content sections are revealed with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, often accompanied by graphic elements drawing into view, likely using a scroll-triggered animation library like GSAP ScrollTrigger or similar CSS keyframes.

The site employs a dark mode aesthetic with a deep black background, using vibrant, soft-focus gradient elements (like the hero orb) to provide visual interest and contrast, creating a futuristic and high-tech atmosphere.

A persistent, minimal navigation bar appears at the bottom of the screen after the initial scroll, providing global access points without cluttering the main content area, while the top logo remains sticky.

design_tokens.type_scale: Small, uppercase monospaced body text (~14px) with larger, also monospaced headings (~2-3x body) and an extremely large, sparse logo.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp, with no visible rounded corners on any elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Extremely airy, characterized by vast expanses of black space between minimal content blocks, creating a sense of depth and focus.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its extreme minimalism, vast black voids, and the consistent use of monospaced, uppercase typography. The glowing, ethereal gradient elements against the deep black background create a unique, futuristic, and almost cosmic aesthetic, setting it apart from typical finance sites.
